cases.name: revoking self
cases.message: You can't revoke the device you're signed in on.

cases.name: not in roster
cases.message: That device has already been removed.

cases.name: last device
cases.message: You can't revoke the last device.

cases.name: not enrolled
cases.message: This device isn't in the account's device list. Sign in again.

cases.name: unreadable
cases.message: One object in this vault can't be re-encrypted, so the key wasn't rotated and nothing was changed. Sign in on a device that can read it.

cases.name: pair no anchor
cases.message: The server sent no device list for this account to anchor on, so there is nothing to pair against.

cases.name: pair server code
cases.message: This device and the new one don't agree on the account's devices. Start the pairing again.

cases.name: pair expired
cases.message: That pairing code has expired. Start the pairing again on the new device.

cases.name: pair key rotated
cases.message: The vault key has been rotated since this device fetched it. Sign in again and approve the new device after that.

cases.name: pair already enrolled
cases.message: That device is already enrolled.

cases.name: pair roster moved
cases.message: The new device started pairing against device list 4 but this account is now on 7. Start the pairing again.

cases.name: pair typed code
cases.message: That code doesn't match the one for this pairing.

cases.name: auth username
cases.message: A name can be 3 to 64 characters of letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, and nothing else.

cases.name: auth phrase
cases.message: That isn't a 24-word recovery phrase. Check for a missing or misspelled word.

cases.name: auth phrase mismatch
cases.message: That recovery phrase doesn't open this account. Check the account name and the words.

cases.name: auth no roster
cases.message: The server sent no device list for this account, so the devices this would restore access alongside can't be checked.

cases.name: auth challenge
cases.message: The server's answer wasn't in the shape a recovery needs. Try again.

cases.name: auth collection moved
cases.message: The server answered with a different vault than the one this device just signed for. Nothing was saved.

cases.name: auth no key wrap
cases.message: This device no longer has access to the vault. It may have been removed.

cases.name: attachment empty
cases.message: That file is empty, so there is nothing to attach.

cases.name: attachment too large
cases.message: That file is 15 MB, over the 10 MB limit for an attachment.

cases.name: attachment mismatch
cases.message: The server's copy of this attachment doesn't match what this device expected, so it wasn't opened. Try again.

cases.name: roster too old
cases.message: This device has been away too long to check the account's device list. Pair it again to carry on.

cases.name: collection busy
cases.message: The vault kept changing while it was being read. Another device may be writing to it; try again.

cases.name: recovery pending
cases.message: This account has an unfinished recovery. Replace the vault key to finish it, which issues a new recovery phrase. Nothing can be saved until then.
